We had an amazing time at the STL Punk Rock Flea Market in Tower Grove Park!

It was so much fun to support local vendors and hear live music from independent artists.

STL loves our small businesses and our arts community!

I’m truly humbled to have the endorsement of icon, actress, author, and activist Jenifer Lewis as I run to return to Congress and keep fighting for St. Louis’ families!

In this moment where our voting rights and our Democracy are under attack, our movement to fight back against Trump and deliver for STL grows every day.

It's great to have such a strong fighter joining us.

NEXT WEEK!

Join us for the launch of Latinos for Cori!

On June 1st, we’re coming together for a virtual phonebank! We need bilingual volunteers from all over to help us have conversations with Spanish-first communities in St. Louis about the issues affecting us here in the 1st District.

Then, on June 6th, we’re joining together with our St. Louis Latino community to organize, mobilize, and fight for progressive values by canvassing in the Dutchtown area!

It was another fantastic year connecting at the African Arts Festival!

It’s always beautiful to see our St. Louis community come together to celebrate and support African art, culture, and educational programs.

See you next year!

This Memorial Day, we remember and honor those who lost their lives in service to our country.

Today and every day, my thoughts are with the families of our service members who made the ultimate sacrifice.

It was wonderful to see Jennings Youth Initiative celebrate their second year of supporting North County.

I’m so proud to see them working to serve our young people with family-friendly events and activities.

Congratulations to all the graduates who were honored!

I had so much fun at the Vivian Whitley Foundation’s first STL Community Car Show parade!

I’m so happy to see our neighbors coming together to support tornado relief.

Thank you to everyone who came out to raise funds for families in need.

When: Sunday, May 24th
Where: 4600 Oakridge Blvd, St. Louis, MO, 63121
RSVP here: mobilize.us/coribush1/event/…

TOMORROW:

Join us for Conversations with Cori in Northwoods!

Today’s community conversation was great—come join us tomorrow afternoon for another discussion with our neighbors about the issues we’re facing here in St. Louis.

We’ll meet at Northwoods City Park to talk about how we'll shape our community’s future together. Can’t wait to see you there!

Thank you so much to everyone who joined us for Conversations with Cori this morning!

I had a great time at the Daily Drip talking with neighbors about how to fight back against attacks on our voting rights, make real progress on tornado recovery, and other issues our community is facing.

For those of you who couldn’t make it, join us tomorrow afternoon in Northwoods for the next Conversations with Cori!

I had so much fun at the last stop of yesterday’s small business tour with owners Brandace and Jada.

B-Juiced brings delicious smoothies, fresh juices, and food to Ferguson. I’m so happy to see them supporting healthy living in Ferguson through high-quality, nutritious ingredients and thoughtfully developed recipes.
